adjustments.description: Settlement of a commercial dispute. Non-recurring.
adjustments.management_rationale: Settlement of commercial dispute - non-recurring. Management advises this relates to a separate matter from FY2023 and FY2024 settlements.
adjustments.reasoning: The identical $2.1M settlement add-back appears in each of FY2023 (ADJ-001), FY2024 (ADJ-002), and FY2025 (ADJ-003). Board minutes Item 7 (22 October 2025) explicitly state: 'the third annual settlement under the ongoing series of commercial disputes with former channel partners had been concluded at $2.1M, consistent with the prior two years.' The Board itself asked whether provision should be made for a further settlement in FY2026. This contemporaneous board-level evidence directly contradicts management's non-recurring classification. The pattern — identical amount, three consecutive years, board discussion of a fourth year — demonstrates a recurring economic pattern. The underlying event is real and the amount is confirmed, but the EBITDA add-back is rejected because the evidence shows the item is recurring and ongoing, not a one-time non-recurring charge appropriate for normalized EBITDA.

existence.detail: Board minutes Item 7 confirm the FY2025 settlement was concluded at $2.1M.

amount.detail: Amount of $2.1M confirmed by board minutes and consistent with ADJ-001 and ADJ-002 in structured data.

period.detail: FY2025 period is consistent with board minutes dated October 2025.

recurrence.detail: SQL confirms identical $2.1M settlement in FY2023, FY2024, and FY2025. Board minutes confirm 'third annual settlement' and ask about FY2026 provision. Three consecutive years at identical amounts with board-level discussion of continuation constitutes a recurring pattern.

duplication.detail: ADJ-001 and ADJ-002 are historical-period adjustments not applied to FY2025. ADJ-003 is the sole FY2025 settlement adjustment. No duplication within FY2025.

underlying_data.detail: No settlement transaction appears in fact_invoice or fact_invoice_line. Settlement payments are not captured in the revenue transaction tables, which is expected for legal settlements.

document_support.detail: Board minutes Item 7 describe an 'ongoing series of commercial disputes' and a 'third annual settlement'. This directly contradicts management's non-recurring classification.

adjustments.what_would_raise_confidence: Settlement agreement documents for FY2023, FY2024, and FY2025 confirming separate counterparties and distinct legal matters. Absence of any FY2026 settlement provision in audited accounts. Legal counsel opinion confirming the series is fully resolved.

adjustments.description: Founder salary above market; normalised to a market rate for the role.
adjustments.management_rationale: Founder salary above market; normalised to market rate. Supported by a third-party compensation benchmark dated Sep-2025.
adjustments.reasoning: Owner compensation normalisation is a standard and well-recognised QoE adjustment for owner-managed businesses. Management references a third-party compensation benchmark dated September 2025. The adjustment appears only once in the structured data (FY2025 only), confirming it is not a recurring add-back across multiple periods. No VDR evidence contradicts the existence of above-market founder compensation or the $1.25M normalisation amount. The adjustment is appropriate for normalised EBITDA as it represents the difference between actual founder compensation and a market-rate replacement cost. Confidence is slightly reduced because the third-party benchmark itself is not directly available in the data room for independent verification of the specific market rate used.

existence.detail: Owner compensation normalisation is a standard QoE adjustment. Management references a Sep-2025 third-party benchmark. No contradicting evidence in VDR.

amount.detail: $1.25M is the management-stated normalisation amount supported by a referenced benchmark. The benchmark document itself is not in the data room for independent verification.

period.detail: FY2025 period is appropriate for a compensation normalisation adjustment.

recurrence.detail: SQL confirms ADJ-004 appears only in FY2025. No prior-year owner compensation normalisation adjustment exists in the structured data.

duplication.detail: No other adjustment in FY2025 relates to owner compensation.

underlying_data.detail: Payroll data is not available in the structured Databricks sources. Cannot independently verify founder salary level or market rate.

adjustments.description: Planned headcount reduction of 14 FTE scheduled for Q1 FY2026. No notice has yet been served.
adjustments.management_rationale: Planned headcount reduction in Q1 FY2026. No notice has yet been served.
adjustments.reasoning: Management explicitly acknowledges in the QoE schedule that no notice has yet been served and the headcount reduction is scheduled for Q1 FY2026 — a future period. This is a prospective cost saving that has not occurred in the FY2025 analysis period. Pro-forma future cost savings that have not been actioned are not appropriate for inclusion in normalised historical EBITDA. The cost has been incurred in FY2025 (the headcount is still employed), and the saving has not been realised. No board minutes or other VDR evidence confirms that the restructuring has been approved, announced, or is contractually committed. The adjustment is rejected as a prospective, unactioned pro-forma item.

existence.detail: Management states the reduction is planned for Q1 FY2026 with no notice served. No board resolution or restructuring plan is evidenced in the VDR.

amount.detail: $1.4M is management's estimate of future savings. No payroll data, redundancy cost schedule, or independent verification is available.

period.detail: The saving relates to FY2026, not FY2025. The cost was incurred in FY2025 and the saving has not been realised in the analysis period.

recurrence.detail: No prior-year pro-forma cost savings adjustment exists in the structured data.

duplication.detail: No other adjustment relates to this headcount reduction.

underlying_data.detail: Headcount and payroll data are not available in the structured Databricks sources.

document_support.detail: No board minutes, restructuring plan, or other VDR document confirms the planned headcount reduction. Board minutes (Oct 2025) do not reference any restructuring programme.

adjustments.what_would_raise_confidence: Board resolution approving the restructuring. Redundancy notices served. Signed settlement agreements with affected employees. Audited FY2026 accounts showing the saving was realised.

adjustments.description: Trading losses on the Legacy On-Prem product, which is being sunset.
adjustments.management_rationale: Losses on Legacy On-Prem product being sunset.
adjustments.reasoning: The dim_product table confirms the existence of a 'Legacy' product family containing 'Legacy On-Prem Licence' (PRD-016, Perpetual delivery model) and 'Legacy Maintenance' (PRD-017, Subscription). This independently corroborates the existence of a Legacy product line. The fact_invoice_line query for Legacy product family returned zero revenue rows in FY2025, which is consistent with the product being sunset and generating losses rather than revenue (the losses would be cost-side, not revenue-side). The adjustment is for trading losses (costs exceeding revenue) on a product being discontinued, which is a legitimate non-recurring QoE add-back when the product is genuinely being sunset. The product family exists in the product master, the delivery model (Perpetual) is consistent with an on-premises legacy product, and no VDR evidence contradicts the sunset rationale. Confidence is reduced because the $540,000 loss amount cannot be independently verified from available structured data (no cost allocation data available).

period.detail: FY2025 is the stated period. Zero Legacy revenue in FY2025 invoice lines is consistent with the product being sunset.

adjustments.category: Pro-forma full-year effect of new logos
adjustments.description: Annualising the FY2025 in-year contribution of logos won during the year.
adjustments.reasoning: This is a pro-forma annualisation adjustment that projects future revenue from new logos won during FY2025 as if they had been active for the full year. SQL analysis identifies 20 customers with first_order_date in FY2025, generating total actual FY2025 revenue of $1,878,956. Management's adjustment of $1,650,000 purports to represent the annualised uplift from these logos. However, this adjustment is rejected for the following reasons: (1) It is prospective and pro-forma — it adds revenue that was not earned in FY2025 to the FY2025 EBITDA base; (2) Historical invoice data alone does not prove future contractual run-rate revenue — continuation requires an unsupported assumption about customer persistence, contract renewal, and revenue stability; (3) Several new logos show only one or two invoices in FY2025 (e.g., Copperfield Markets with one invoice in November 2025, Glenmoor Markets with one invoice in April 2025), making annualisation highly assumption-dependent; (4) The annualisation methodology is not independently reconstructable from authoritative evidence without assuming revenue persistence; (5) Pro-forma future revenue without sufficient evidence that it belongs in historical normalised EBITDA is a standard rejection category. The actual new logo revenue earned in FY2025 ($1,878,956) is already captured in reported EBITDA. The adjustment seeks to add an additional $1,650,000 of revenue that was not earned.

existence.detail: SQL confirms 20 new customers (first_order_date in FY2025) with total FY2025 actual revenue of $1,878,956. New logos exist and generated revenue.

amount.detail: Management's $1,650,000 annualisation uplift cannot be independently reconstructed from authoritative evidence without assuming revenue persistence, run-rate, and full-year contribution. The actual in-year revenue of $1,878,956 is already in reported EBITDA.

period.detail: The adjustment adds prospective revenue to historical FY2025 EBITDA. The annualised uplift relates to FY2026 and beyond, not FY2025.

recurrence.detail: No prior-year pro-forma new logo annualisation adjustment exists in the structured data.

duplication.detail: No other FY2025 adjustment relates to new logo annualisation.

underlying_data.detail: SQL shows new logo revenue of $1,878,956 actually earned in FY2025. Many new logos have only 1-3 invoices, making full-year run-rate assumptions unreliable. Cascade Foods Holdings (CUST-0006) accounts for $1,206,022 of new logo revenue — 64% of the total — with only 3 invoices (June, July, October 2025). Annualising from partial-year data for a single large customer introduces material assumption risk.

document_support.detail: No executed contracts for new FY2025 logos (other than Cascade Foods Holdings via DOC-06) are available in the data room to confirm contracted ARR or ACV supporting the annualisation basis.

adjustments.what_would_raise_confidence: Executed contracts for all new FY2025 logos confirming contracted ACV/ARR. Invoices covering a full 12-month period for each new logo. Management's annualisation methodology and workings showing how $1,650,000 was derived from specific customer contracts.

sql_evidence.purpose: Team Adjusted EBITDA and earnings challenge calculation
sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN adjustment_id IN ('ADJ-004','ADJ-006','ADJ-007','ADJ-009') THEN amount_usd ELSE 0 END) as accepted_total, SUM(CASE WHEN adjustment_id IN ('ADJ-003','ADJ-005','ADJ-010') THEN amount_usd ELSE 0 END) as rejected_total, 4280000 + SUM(CASE WHEN adjustment_id IN ('ADJ-004','ADJ-006','ADJ-007','ADJ-009') THEN amount_usd ELSE 0 END) as team_adjusted_ebitda, 4280000 + SUM(amount_usd) as mgmt_adjusted_ebitda, SUM(amount_usd) as mgmt_total_adjustments FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.mgmt_ebitda_adjustment WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025'

SELECT 4280000 as reported_ebitda_usd, 8120000 as mgmt_adjustments_total_usd, 4280000 + 8120000 as mgmt_adjusted_ebitda_usd, 2970000 as accepted_adjustments_total_usd, 5150000 as challenged_or_rejected_adjustments_total_usd, 4280000 + 2970000 as team_adjusted_ebitda_usd, 12400000 - (4280000 + 2970000) as earnings_challenge_usd, CASE WHEN (4280000 + 8120000) = 12400000 THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END as management_bridge_reconciles, CASE WHEN (4280000 + 2970000) = 7250000 THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END as team_bridge_reconciles, 12400000 - 12400000 as reconciliation_difference_usd
sql_evidence.result_summary: reported_ebitda=4280000, mgmt_adjustments=8120000, mgmt_adjusted_ebitda=12400000, accepted_adjustments=2970000, challenged_rejected=5150000, team_adjusted_ebitda=7250000, earnings_challenge=5150000, management_bridge_reconciles=TRUE, team_bridge_reconciles=TRUE, reconciliation_difference=0.

sql_evidence.purpose: New logo revenue test for ADJ-010 pro-forma annualisation
sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.first_order_date, MIN(fi.invoice_date) as first_invoice_date, MAX(fi.invoice_date) as last_invoice_date, SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd) as fy2025_revenue, COUNT(fi.invoice_id) as invoice_count FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON fi.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE fi.invoice_date >= '2025-01-01' AND fi.invoice_date <= '2025-12-31' AND c.first_order_date >= '2025-01-01' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.first_order_date ORDER BY fy2025_revenue DESC
sql_evidence.result_summary: 20 new logos identified with first_order_date in FY2025. Total actual FY2025 revenue from new logos: $1,878,956. Largest new logo: Cascade Foods Holdings $1,206,022 (3 invoices). Many logos have only 1 invoice. Annualisation is assumption-dependent and not independently reconstructable.

sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd) as total_fy2025_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi WHERE fi.invoice_date >= '2025-01-01' AND fi.invoice_date <= '2025-12-31'
sql_evidence.result_summary: total_fy2025_revenue = $42,730,073. Consistent with CIM Page 9 stating revenue over $42M in FY2025.

unresolved_items.description: Legacy On-Prem trading loss of $540,000 (ADJ-007) cannot be independently verified from available structured data. No cost allocation data is available. The product family exists in dim_product and zero Legacy revenue in invoice lines is consistent with sunset, but the loss amount remains management-stated.

unresolved_items.resolution: Obtain management accounts or P&L allocation showing Legacy On-Prem cost base and revenue for FY2025.

unresolved_items.description: ADJ-008 (FY2024, aborted refinancing costs, $180,000) is present in the structured mgmt_ebitda_adjustment table but absent from the management QoE schedule (DOC-08). The reason for this omission is unclear.
unresolved_items.impact: Inconsistency INC-002 recorded. No impact on FY2025 EBITDA bridge as ADJ-008 is a FY2024 historical item.
unresolved_items.resolution: Management to confirm whether ADJ-008 was intentionally excluded from the QoE schedule and whether it was applied to FY2024 reported EBITDA.

data_quality.observation: Legacy product family (PRD-016, PRD-017) exists in dim_product but has zero invoice line records in fact_invoice_line across all periods. This is consistent with a sunset product but may also indicate incomplete data loading for legacy transactions.
data_quality.impact: Cannot independently verify Legacy On-Prem revenue or loss from invoice data.

data_quality.observation: No payroll, HR, or cost allocation data is available in the structured Databricks sources. This prevents independent verification of ADJ-004 (owner compensation), ADJ-005 (headcount savings), ADJ-007 (Legacy losses), and ADJ-009 (recruitment fees).
data_quality.impact: Four adjustments rely on management-stated amounts that cannot be independently verified from available structured data.

data_quality.observation: The mgmt_ebitda_adjustment table does not contain a description column — only category and mgmt_rationale. The QoE schedule (DOC-08) provides more detailed descriptions. Reconciliation between structured data and document was performed using adjustment_id and amount.
data_quality.impact: Minor — reconciliation completed successfully using available fields.
